text: {"established":["The stage 3 candidate, with balances [-124,-157,-266,494,-193,59], received a public_mismatch on the released balance-0 check; no replacement answer was supplied.","The stage 1 and stage 2 candidates received public_pass receipts with 22 and 45 checks, respectively.
